topic: Meta Muse AI agent in Instagram DMs (24 Nov) + Reuters test: Muse saw Signal text on Android/Mac (18 Nov)
caption:
Meta's AI agent just moved into your Instagram DMs.

Since 24 Nov, Muse can sit inside your chats: it sorts saved posts, turns a recipe reel into a grocery list, and helps you catch up on DMs you missed. It's rolling out in the US, Canada, Mexico, Japan and Singapore.

The twist: six days earlier, Reuters tested Muse with Signal and the AI Now Institute. It could see encrypted Signal message text on an Android phone and a Mac through notification and accessibility access. It was blocked on an iPhone. Meta called these isolated incidents and says Muse only reaches other apps with permissions you grant.

What you can do: only give it the access you need, think twice before notification access, and ask it to forget anything you shared.

Would you let an AI read your DMs? 👇

Source: TechCrunch, Reuters, Meta
